hypotheses.A0_exact_tensor_and_manual_forward_close: Manual QK/value/bilinear execution matches native answer logits and the explicit bilinear tensor matches the natural residual write to maximum error at most 1e-5 in every run.
hypotheses.A1_raw_address_does_not_generalize_rando: Raw ID-digit and relation features have selected-fact held-out-template write R-squared below 0.10 in every run.
hypotheses.A2_premlp_linear_state_is_sufficient: A linear map from the normalized final pre-MLP state reaches median finite-effect fidelity at least 0.70 on selected held-out-template facts in every run.
hypotheses.A3_quadratic_state_repairs_linear_failur: Rank-32 quadratic pre-MLP features improve selected held-out-template effect fidelity by at least 0.10 over the linear pre-MLP map and reach at least 0.80 in every run.
hypotheses.A4_memory_is_readable_before_final_atten: A rank-64 code of the complete Layer-2 residual sequence reaches selected held-out-template effect fidelity at least 0.70 in every run.
hypotheses.A5_qk_address_is_sufficient: Final-query QK attention patterns alone reach selected held-out-template effect fidelity at least 0.50 in every run.
hypotheses.A6_local_state_atlas_is_sufficient: Eight-nearest-neighbor pre-MLP routing reaches selected held-out-template effect fidelity at least 0.70 in every run.
hypotheses.A7_selected_facts_are_not_materially_har: The best non-oracle selected-fact effect fidelity is within 0.15 of the best unselected-fact fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.A8_fact_specific_write_residual_is_predi: At least one non-oracle method reaches selected held-out-template oracle-relation-answer-residual write R-squared at least 0.50 in every run.
hypotheses.A9_oracle_answer_prototype_is_a_strong_b: The relation-and-answer prototype reaches selected held-out-template effect fidelity at least 0.80 in every run.
hypotheses.A10_real_state_beats_shuffled_target_con: Rank-32 quadratic pre-MLP effect fidelity exceeds its shuffled-write control by at least 0.20 on selected held-out-template facts in every run.
hypotheses.A11_causal_signal_gate_passes: Every reported status/template panel has at least 64 examples whose natural final-MLP write has Fisher effect norm at least 0.1.
